name: Nutrien Redwater nitrogen complex
description: Operating nitrogen complex in Alberta with gross annual capacity of 1.0 Mt ammonia and 0.7 Mt urea; the site produces low-carbon ammonia with CO2 sent to the Alberta Carbon Trunk Line and was certified under the TFI Verified Ammonia Carbon Intensity programme in 2025.

capacities.basis: gross annual capacity, including allowances for normal operating plant conditions

Nutrien story on Redwater's TFI Verified Ammonia Carbon Intensity certification (February 2025) and CO2 sent to the Alberta Carbon Trunk Line, read 2026-11-17

notes: The site is quoted at 950,000 gross tonnes of ammonia and other nitrogen-based fertilizers, with more than 800 tonnes per day of CO2 sent to the Alberta Carbon Trunk Line after the 2023 expansion. Nutrien cites up to 1 million tonnes of low-carbon ammonia production capability across Redwater, Geismar and Joffre. GCCSI's November 2024 report lists 'WCS Redwater' as operational since 2020, capturing 0.3 Mtpa CO2 for enhanced oil recovery; GCCSI does not use the Nutrien name or state an ammonia capacity.
